name: covariance identity for sizing decisions
evidence: E[w r] = E[w]E[r] + Cov(w,r); identity closes to 1.4e-20; 77% of the numerator difference runs through the covariance term
why: never selected from a pool, so it carries no selection bias by construction -- which is exactly why it survived

name: log(VIX) incremental over HAR for forecasting realised volatility
evidence: t = 14.13 (SPY h=5), dR2 0.03-0.06, survives four artefact tests; and sizing on HAR+log(VIX) was WORSE than sizing on HAR in 8 of 8 comparisons on all pre-TEST data
why: BOTH statuses are required and neither may be dropped. As CALIBRATION_PASS it is an independent re-derivation of a standard literature result, evidence the harness detects real effects. As EXEMPLAR_COVARIANCE_THESIS it is the strongest single example of CR-1: an overwhelming forecast improvement that does not improve the decision.

name: multiplicity arithmetic
evidence: lambda measured per family (1.705 / 1.195 / 0.999); exact max-|z| quantiles; threshold-vs-K curve to K = 1268; MDE_IC floor 0.0796 at K = 1 in the returns regime
magnitude: cost of the search space exceeded every known real return effect
why: a fact about method, not about markets; portable to any search
